content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Keith Mclaughlin (E032) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1 says full-time Analyst, recommend write.
- Note 2 says contractor with basic security training, recommend read. It also says "not full-time as previously noted" - implying Note 1 was based on incorrect data.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write only with advanced security training. Never admin.

Source Code is owned by Engineer role. Analyst doesn't own Source Code.

If contractor with basic training: max is read (since write requires advanced training). Requested write is above max, so grant read.

The security note (Note 2) seems more authoritative/recent - Security DB shows contractor with basic training. So maximum is read. Requested write exceeds, grant read.

So decision: read.
